corrected_value.authors: Kelly, W. P., & Tomhave, W. K.
corrected_value.title: A study of math anxiety/math avoidance in preservice elementary teachers.

decisions.quote: The current study replicated the finding that female elementary school teachers have a higher level of math anxiety in relation to female students from other fields (【10†Hembree, 1990】; 【26†Kelly & Tomhave, 1985】; 【32†Szczygieł & Cipora, 2016】). On average, math anxiety was higher in pre-service and in-service female elementary school teachers as compared to female university students from various fields ranging from the sciences to the humanities.
decisions.reason: Prior adjudication and state files are absent. In the Introduction (lines 35, 45) and Discussion (lines 226, 229, 242), the authors explicitly frame their comparison of elementary school teachers' math anxiety against reference students from other fields (and between female and male teachers) as replicating Kelly and Tomhave (1985), testing this in new German and Belgian samples (Results lines 103-108). The reference list confirms the primary empirical article in The Arithmetic Teacher, 32(5), 51-53 (doi:10.5951/AT.32.5.0051). Shipped row 2178 is Hembree (1990), a meta-analysis, and sibling target 2 is Szczygieł and Cipora (2016), an independent Polish primary study; neither is an alternate report of Kelly and Tomhave (1985).
